old: CO<sub>3</sub> is the carbonate ion, not a gas; carbonic acid does not release H<sub>2</sub>.
new: Neutral CO<sub>3</sub> is not a real compound (carbonate is the CO<sub>3</sub><sup>2−</sup> ion), and carbonic acid does not release H<sub>2</sub>.
why: Feedback mislabels neutral CO3 as the carbonate ion; carbonate carries a 2- charge.
